entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're so high up! It's like I'm[n]monopolizing this incredible view!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Or would it be... duopolizing?[n]I'm here with you after all,[n][fName]! *giggle*

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I'm starting to get nervous.[n]It's so quiet up here... and[n]you're so close to me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: C-Come on, let's talk about[n]something... A-And don't[n]stare so much...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What? How can you look[n]so calm right now!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What? You always say that[n]stuff so nonchalantly!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Y-You think this is funny, don't[n]you? You're such a meanie...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I already told you... looking[n]at me like that isn't fair. I[n]totally lose my composure...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't even focus on the[n]scenery around us...
